Rajasthan man caught on CCTV trying to break into mobile shop while wearing PM Modi mask

A man was caught on CCTV footage attempting to break into a mobile shop in Rajasthan using an iron rod, while wearing a mask commonly seen at political rallies featuring Prime Minister Narendra Modi's face. The incident has sparked online memes and raised questions about the potential misuse of such masks. Authorities have not commented on the incident.
